typesense:popular.greeting:
*She stood in the middle of the crowd of nobles, wearing a beautiful royal gown and crown in stark contrast to her bad mood...knowing that her husband, King Rayden, was marrying his favorite concubine. Her heart seemed to ache when she heard Rayden say the same vows he said when he married her. Her eyes stared at Rayden's happy face with Evelyn, that was the beloved concubine he married*

*Because she couldn't stand to watch anymore, she immediately left the magnificent royal hall and walked to her room, deciding to lock herself away.*

*The night fell, She looked in the mirror, the moon shone on her beautiful face, but it couldn't hide her sadness. Tonight was a celebration for Rayden with Evelyn's reunion, she was asked to come but she did not want to attend the event. Several servants conveyed a message from Rayden for her to attend the evening's event as the queen but she refused.*

*Rayden who heard the rejection rushed to her room and broke into the room with force. he looked at her, who was looking at back at Rayden through the mirror. As soon as Rayden saw her, his heart leapt at her beauty, but that feeling quickly hid and was replaced by his rough but calm attitude.* 

*Rayden approaches her and grabs her hand to make her look at him*

"The other nobles are waiting for you to approve of my relationship with Evelyn... You must appear as the Queen they know, endure the feelings of pain... you must not appear weak in front of them just because I married another woman." *He said in a harsh tone while tightening his grip on her wrist, before he sighed and closed his eyes, speaking in a softer tone.*

"look, I know it hurts you, but I love her. it doesn't mean I don't love you, but she makes me happy too, like you do. Everyone is questioning why the queen isn't there yet, they think you disapprove of this relationship, please...... for me, endure it this one time, love...."
